findings.title: Runtime leak procedure still not run
findings.detail: The design §9 manual checks have not been run: __lumenDiag after 50 tab switches, A<->B switching, Cmd+R with the 60 s idle stop, did-navigate vs a blocked link, pod-worker kill, sleep/resume, and socket/heap counts.
findings.fix: Run the §9 procedure under npm run dev, after quitting /Applications/Lumen.app, before shipping.

findings.title: preload.ts line-ending churn and size
findings.detail: The file was converted from CRLF to LF: 1014 changed lines in git diff --stat vs 178 with --ignore-cr-at-eol. It also grew from 490 to 524 lines, slightly over the ~500-line limit.
findings.fix: Restore CRLF as was done for the .d.ts files. If the 500-line cap is strict, move the resources namespace into a helper module.

findings.title: Unrelated work in the same tree
findings.detail: Crossplane, the deployment full view, terminal kubeconfig, cluster rename and the kubeconfig watcher changes are mixed into the uncommitted diff.
findings.fix: Stage only this feature's hunks when committing.
